title: zea mays convar. polystachytes
intro: Zea mays convar. polystachytes, commonly known as tall maize or Japanese corn, is a subspecies of maize native to East Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Zea mays convar. polystachytes include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from infections and diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
